research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: TestRigor, Inc. is focused on enhancing automated testing processes for applications. Their R&D efforts include a technique for mapping interactive elements within application user interfaces, which facilitates the identification and interaction with GUI components during testing. Additionally, they are developing methods to generate automated tests by analyzing end-user interactions, allowing for the creation of tests that reflect real-world usage. Moreover, they are researching the application of machine learning to detect errors in GUIs by processing screenshots. These initiatives aim to streamline the testing process and improve the accuracy of automated test generation and error detection.

overview_description.description: TestRigor offers a codeless test automation tool powered by generative AI, designed to help manual testers and product managers. Comprising a team of engineers and data scientists, the company developed testRigor with a focus on catering to fast-paced startups in industries where the critical functionality of applications is paramount. TestRigor is dedicated to empowering developers and QA teams to leverage the capabilities of machine learning, pushing the limits of software testing.
